instruction: Find information about vehicle registration in Virginia

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Virginia DMV homepage to the vehicle registration page. Evaluator checks if the final URL matches the expected pattern for vehicle registration pages. Uses existing getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree (Chrome address bar)
Metric correctly performs regex pattern matching on the extracted URL
Expected regex pattern appropriately identifies Virginia DMV vehicle registration page
Evaluator checks the only requirement: navigating to the vehicle registration information page
URL state persists after navigation, no postconfig needed
Regex pattern allows flexibility (no $ anchor) for URL variations like query parameters or trailing content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding explicit test for common URL variations (e.g., /vehicles/registrations/, /vehicles/registrations.aspx) to ensure robustness, though current regex without $ anchor should handle these
